Enrichment lollipop bar

Source: R/fig_enrich.R
fig_enrich_bar.Rd

Bars of -log10(FDR), colored by direction (GSEA) or a single hue (ORA).

Usage

fig_enrich_bar(
  df,
  n = 20,
  col_up = "#C0392B",
  col_down = "#2980B9",
  mode = c("exploration", "publication")
)

Arguments

df

a data.frame from run_gsea() or run_ora()

n

number of top terms (by padj) to show

col_up, col_down

colors for positive / negative NES (GSEA only)

mode

"exploration" or "publication"

Value

a ggplot2 object
